# Taken 2026-10-30 on container 1.6.1 (macOS 27.0.1), by asking the runtime directly and then
# through opossum built from this change. Two local images, built here and removed afterwards:
# opossum-probe-several:1 lists linux/amd64 and linux/s390x, opossum-probe-noamd:1 lists
# linux/s390x and linux/ppc64le; neither lists arm64. Both from `FROM alpine:3.20` with
# `CMD ["uname","-m"]`, built with `container build --platform … --platform …`.
#
# 1.6.1 takes the platform from the image: one that lists several and none of them this host's
# is refused, with the list, until a platform is given (`--rosetta` alone does not do it), and
# `--platform linux/amd64` runs the amd64 build. The order of the list is not fixed (another
# run of the first command listed amd64 first). No container is left after a refusal.
# The service with `platform: linux/amd64` ran and exited at once (its CMD is `uname -m`),
# which is OPSM-407, not a failure of the platform: its log says x86_64.
# Only local images were measured: what a first pull of such an image from a registry says has
# not been.

$ container --version
container CLI version 1.6.1 (build: release, commit: unspeci)

$ container run --rm --name opossum-probe-run opossum-probe-several:1
--- exit code: 1
--- stdout ---
--- stderr ---
[0/6] [0s]
[0/6] [0s]
Error: image opossum-probe-several:1 has multiple platforms ([ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "s390x"), ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "amd64")]); pass --os/--arch or set a default

$ container run --rm --name opossum-probe-run --rosetta opossum-probe-several:1
--- exit code: 1
--- stdout ---
--- stderr ---
[0/6] [0s]
[0/6] [0s]
Error: image opossum-probe-several:1 has multiple platforms ([ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "s390x"), ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "amd64")]); pass --os/--arch or set a default

$ container run --rm --name opossum-probe-run --platform linux/amd64 opossum-probe-several:1
--- exit code: 0
--- stdout ---
x86_64
--- stderr ---

[6/6] Starting container [0s]

$ container run --rm --name opossum-probe-run opossum-probe-noamd:1
--- exit code: 1
--- stdout ---
--- stderr ---
[0/6] [0s]
[0/6] [0s]
Error: image opossum-probe-noamd:1 has multiple platforms ([ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "ppc64le"), ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "s390x")]); pass --os/--arch or set a default

$ container ls -a (names starting opossum-probe)
(none)

# opossum up, compose.yaml: services.several.image = opossum-probe-several:1, no platform
$ opossum up
--- exit code: 1
--- stdout ---
Creating network p9probe-net
Starting several (opossum-probe-several:1)
Nothing this `up` started is left running
--- stderr ---
[0/6] [0s]
[0/6] [0s]
Error: image opossum-probe-several:1 has multiple platforms ([ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "s390x"), ContainerizationOCI.Platform(osVersion: nil, osFeatures: nil, variant: nil, _rawOS: "linux", _rawArch: "amd64")]); pass --os/--arch or set a default
opossum: starting service "several": exit status 1
  → [OPSM-412] this image has no build for Apple silicon (arm64). Add `platform: linux/amd64` to the service — opossum runs an amd64 image through Rosetta.
